comments.body_html: It’s a generic hit that happens with some dll’s from many mods, including those from Nexus who runs their own checks. It is 100% safe in regards of the average user downloading and using the affected mod. But generally, you have the right mindset and should for the most part trust Windows Defender. If you did compile it yourself, verified that it has nothing harmful, and build the mod, it will give out trojan errors as well. It’s just something that happens with some files. Luckily Microsoft has a function to upload files to them so they can roll out a patch for Windows Defender.
